Lisa · Listen & Shadow 07

Before the Wine — the kitchen, leaving, the turn, what it left
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE KITCHEN
👤 Brian
Why cooking, in the first place?
왜 요리였어요?
in the first place — 애초에
💬 Lisa
I went to culinary school because I wanted to work with my hands.
요리학교에 간 건 손으로 만드는 일이 하고 싶어서였어요.
culinary school — 요리학교 · work with one's hands — 손으로 일하다
같은 패턴으로 — I went into it because I wanted something physical. · I chose it because I liked the pace.
💬 Lisa
My first kitchen was small and completely chaotic.
첫 주방은 작고 미친 듯이 바빴어요.
chaotic — 정신없는, 혼란스러운
같은 패턴으로 — My first job was small and loud. · The first place was chaotic but fun.
💬 Lisa
The hours were long — twelve-hour days.
근무 시간이 길었어요 — 하루 열두 시간씩요.
the hours — 근무 시간
같은 패턴으로 — The hours were brutal. · The shifts ran late.
💬 Lisa
You learn fast or you leave.
거기선 빨리 배우거나 나가거나예요.
learn fast — 빨리 배우다
같은 패턴으로 — You keep up or you're out. · You adapt or you quit.
💬 Lisa
What I was best at was sauces.
제가 제일 잘한 건 소스였어요.
be best at ~ — ~를 제일 잘하다
같은 패턴으로 — What I was best at was plating. · What I was worst at was pastry.
PART 2 · LEAVING
👤 Brian
Why Singapore?
왜 싱가포르였어요?
why ~ — 왜 ~
💬 Lisa
A senior chef told me to go abroad.
선배가 밖에 나가보라고 했어요.
senior — 선배 · go abroad — 외국에 나가다
같은 패턴으로 — A friend told me to apply. · My manager told me to take it.
💬 Lisa
I thought it would be different there.
거기 가면 뭔가 다를 줄 알았어요.
I thought it would be ~ — ~일 줄 알았다
같은 패턴으로 — I thought it would be easier. · I thought it would change everything.
💬 Lisa
What I actually found was the same kitchen in another language.
막상 가보니 똑같은 주방이었어요, 언어만 달랐죠.
what I actually found was ~ — 막상 가보니 ~였다
같은 패턴으로 — What I found was more of the same. · What I found was a lot less glamour.
💬 Lisa
The money was the problem.
돈이 문제였어요.
the problem — 문제
같은 패턴으로 — The rent was the problem. · Time was the real problem.
💬 Lisa
I didn't know anyone there.
거기엔 아는 사람이 하나도 없었어요.
know anyone — 아는 사람이 있다
같은 패턴으로 — I didn't know the city at all. · I didn't speak the language then.
PART 3 · THE TURN
👤 Brian
When did you know cooking wasn't it?
요리가 아니라는 걸 언제 알았어요?
wasn't it — 그게 아니었다
💬 Lisa
It stopped being what I wanted when a guest asked me about the wine.
손님이 와인 얘기를 물었을 때 이게 아니다 싶었어요.
stop being ~ — 더 이상 ~가 아니게 되다
같은 패턴으로 — It stopped being fun when it became routine. · It changed for me that night.
💬 Lisa
I just walked in and asked if they were hiring.
그냥 들어가서 일자리 있냐고 물었어요.
walk in — 들어가다 · hiring — 사람을 뽑는
같은 패턴으로 — I just called and asked. · I walked in with no appointment.
💬 Lisa
I had nothing to lose.
잃을 게 없었어요.
nothing to lose — 잃을 게 없는
같은 패턴으로 — I had nothing lined up. · I had no plan B, honestly.
💬 Lisa
Looking back, I was lucky with the timing.
지금 보면 그 타이밍이 운이 좋았어요.
looking back — 돌아보면 · timing — 시점
같은 패턴으로 — Looking back, I was lucky someone said yes. · Looking back, it was the right year.
💬 Lisa
Scared, yes — but staying in the kitchen scared me more.
무섭긴 했는데, 주방에 남는 게 더 무서웠어요.
scared — 무서운
같은 패턴으로 — Nervous, yes — but not enough to stop. · Scared, but not of failing.
💬 Lisa
Nobody told me I could.
누가 해도 된다고 한 적은 없어요.
nobody told me ~ — 아무도 ~라고 안 했다
같은 패턴으로 — Nobody gave me permission. · Nobody in my family had done it.
PART 4 · WHAT IT LEFT
👤 Brian
What did the kitchen leave in you?
주방이 남긴 게 뭐예요?
leave in ~ — ~에 남기다
💬 Lisa
It taught me not to rush when everything's on fire.
거기서 서두르지 않는 법을 배웠어요.
rush — 서두르다 · on fire — 난리인
같은 패턴으로 — It taught me to prep before I start. · It taught me to clean as I go.
💬 Lisa
I still set everything up before I start, because of those years.
그때 때문에 아직도 준비를 먼저 다 해놔요.
set up — 미리 준비하다
같은 패턴으로 — I still arrive early because of that. · I still check twice because of it.
💬 Lisa
I wouldn't go back, but I miss the rhythm.
돌아가진 않겠지만, 그 리듬은 그리워요.
rhythm — 리듬, 호흡
같은 패턴으로 — I wouldn't go back, but I miss the team. · I don't miss it, except the people.
💬 Lisa
If someone asked me, I'd tell them to try it and find out.
누가 물으면, 일단 해보라고 할 거예요.
find out — 직접 알아보다
같은 패턴으로 — If someone asked, I'd say go early. · I'd tell them to give it two years.
💬 Lisa
The one thing I'd change is leaving sooner.
하나 바꾼다면 더 일찍 옮겼을 거예요.
the one thing I'd change — 하나 바꾼다면
같은 패턴으로 — The one thing I'd change is asking for help. · The one thing I'd redo is the timing.
녹음 25/25
